I am a **Licensed Psychologist** and **PhD Candidate in Psychological Sciences** at the University of Padova, where I am a member of the **[Psicostat](https://psicostat.dpss.psy.unipd.it/)** research group.

I am currently a **Visiting PhD Student** at the **Department of Data Science, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (Harvard Medical School)** in Boston, working under the supervision of **Prof. Giovanni Parmigiani**.

My research combines **clinical psychology and statistical methodology**, with a focus on improving the robustness, transparency, and replicability of psychological research.

In particular, I develop and apply **inferential methods for Multiverse Meta-Analysis**, including **[PIMMA (Post-selection Inference in Multiverse Meta-Analysis)](https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/8ejsn_v1)**, to investigate how analytical decisions affect statistical inference and scientific conclusions.


## Research Interests
::: {.interests-list}
* **Statistics**
  * Meta-analysis, Multiverse analysis, Permutation-based inference
* **Clinical Psychology**
  * Psychotherapy efficacy, Clinical trial methodology
* **Open Science**
  * Research replicability, Philosophy of Science
:::
